name: Summer Science Academy
operator_name: Bridgewater State University, Center for the Advancement of STEM Education (CASE)
description_short: One week in person STEM classes at Bridgewater State University, 8:30 to 2:30, held in the science and math center. High school students in grades 9 to 11 study the human body from a medical angle; middle schoolers in grades 6 to 8 take cybersecurity classes with Sphero robots or a forensics class.
refund_policy_summary: Written cancellation more than one month before the program gets a refund less a $50 fee; more than two weeks before gets 50% less the $50 fee; no refund after that, or if the required CampDocs forms are not in two weeks before.

sessions.name: The Human Body from a Medical Mindset (grades 9 to 11)
CyberFlight: Taking Cyber Skills to New Heights! (grades 6 to 8)

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Science Academy page, Summer 2027. High school track: grades 9 to 11 and at least 15 by October 1, fee $400. Middle school track: grades 6 to 8 and at least 12 by October 1, fee $300 per class. All classes 8:30 to 2:30 in the Dana Mohler-Faria Science & Mathematics Center on the main campus; street address and ZIP are the university's, from the same page's footer. Fee does not include lunch or transportation. $25 early discount before April 1; 5% sibling or multi week discount; need based scholarships due March 31. Registration closes one month before each class. Grades recorded as entering grades 7 to 12 (the page says currently in grades 6 to 8 or 9 to 11, entering 7 to 9 or 10 to 12). Age_min is the stated minimum of 12; age_max derived from entering grade 12. The page also lists a February 2027 Winter Science Academy class, not included.

unknowns: Extended care (a late pickup fee applies, no after care is offered on the page)
